comment: The core script include order, in one place. Every protected page loads these in this sequence; tests/checks/structure.test.js enforces it, and CLAUDE.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md cite this file rather than restating it. It was stated in three places before, and all three were stale: none of them mentioned links.js, detail.js, blocks.js, drawer.js, sprints.js or send-tool.js, and the gate checked five of the fourteen.

rules.position: In <head>. theme.js first and render-blocking so the stored theme is applied before first paint; everything after it carries defer, which keeps them off the first-paint path while preserving execution order.
rules.after: A page's own modules from assets/js/pages/ come after all of these, in dependency order.
rules.config: supabase.js carries the public URL and anon key, so there is no separate config include. The optional gitignored core/config.js may define window.APP_CONFIG before it.
rules.optional: The optional modules are inserted after ui.js, in dependency order, and their exact slot is the page's business - sprints.js sits last on the roadmap page, blocks.js before links.js on platform. Only the universal sequence is fixed and enforced.

login-page.note: No guard.js: it would redirect the login page to itself.

universal.purpose: Applies the stored or OS theme to <html> before first paint.
The Supabase client. Pinned to an exact version so browsers cache it immutably (tests/checks/perf.test.js).
Creates App.db from the public project config.
App.registry: modules, table names, roles, link kinds, departments. The single source of truth for what the hub contains.
App.requireAuth and App.onAuthed. Absent from index.html, which would redirect itself.
Nav rendering, App.escape, badges, App.download, App.store.
App.search: the nav's global search across every reachable source.
App.tools: nav links out to external tools, built from portal_links rows.
App.sendTool and App.daopayAdminTool: the nav's two console-snippet tools. One file because they were built the same way twice.

optional.purpose: App.links: typed knowledge links and their far-end titles. Platform and roadmap.
App.blocks: the typed-block renderer. Six pages.
App.detail: the facts contract that makes a stored column visible without per-page markup. Ten pages.
App.drawer: focus-trapping open/close. The app-review wave page.
App.sprints: sprint codes to date ranges. The roadmap page.
